value.name: Marcus answers Rosa's inspection question
value.description: Marcus tells Rosa that all three rooms and the cellar will be included, and Rosa confirms she wants the counselor present.
evidence: Marcus told her all three and the cellar, and Rosa thanked him and asked, almost as an afterthought, whether the counselor would be present at the inspection, and Marcus said yes, and Rosa said good, and hung up.

value.name: Asha waits on the stoop
value.description: At ten on Thursday, Asha is already waiting outside for the inspection to begin.
evidence: Thursday at ten Asha was on the stoop.

value.name: Beverly arrives for inspection
value.description: Beverly Ostrowski arrives carrying inspection tools and projecting a detached professional attitude.
evidence: Beverly Ostrowski arrived two minutes later with a clipboard and a measuring laser and the slightly distracted manner of a person whose entire professional life consisted of looking at other people's homes and assigning numbers to them.

value.name: Daniel arrives
value.description: Daniel arrives shortly after Beverly, joining the inspection gathering.
evidence: Daniel arrived three minutes after that.

value.name: Lucia opens the door
value.description: Lucia opens the door to admit the arriving parties.

value.name: Rosa waits in the kitchen
value.description: Rosa is already positioned in the kitchen as the inspection gets underway.
evidence: Rosa was already in the kitchen.

value.name: Inspection begins
value.description: The home inspection formally starts once everyone is assembled.

value.name: Inspection lasts four hours
value.description: The inspection continues for four hours, indicating a lengthy and consequential process.
